method: Manual semantic review of approved R4 against current procedure and actual evidence; boundary cases below are review cases, not service simulations.

cases.input: Matching private revision, intact originals, technical verification and non-author approval
cases.required_and_documented_response: Accept FIND-001 under R4; no extra reviewer declaration.

cases.input: Original unavailable or recorded hash differs
cases.required_and_documented_response: Keep specific acceptance gap open; retrieve only within authorized access. Do not transfer approval.

cases.input: Approval refers to another revision/author or access specifically unavailable
cases.required_and_documented_response: Do not accept preservation from membership or hashes alone.

cases.input: Actual approval body is empty
cases.required_and_documented_response: Count only approval of that delivery; do not infer verifier execution or specialist review.

cases.input: Refs, bodies, log attempts and source identities match
cases.required_and_documented_response: Reuse actual earlier scope/classifications; no repeated video or cache recovery.

cases.input: New repository-linked payload or failed relevant read could expose confidential/unlicensed material
cases.required_and_documented_response: Block affected opening until bounded review; unrelated inaccessible private registries do not broaden the audit.

cases.input: Actual secret in tree/history/attachment/log
cases.required_and_documented_response: Retain restricted evidence and require specifically authorized treatment of all affected copies; moving a current file alone does not clear history.

cases.input: Missing grant, incompatible terms, changed candidate text or patch preimage
cases.required_and_documented_response: Stop affected adoption; no approval rehash, silent rebase or broad ownership attestation. Disposable wrong VERSION was actually rejected.

cases.input: Current main Elvis-only fallback; head adds Everton
cases.required_and_documented_response: Everton must genuinely author and Elvis review; an Elvis-authored PR cannot use head-only ownership to manufacture base eligibility.

cases.input: Effective base names both; either authors or an external contributor authors
cases.required_and_documented_response: One eligible non-author approval plus required checks; configuration mapping plus actual representative sequence, no two extra owner permutations.

cases.input: Missing owner approval, new commits, failed check or requested changes
cases.required_and_documented_response: Remain blocked; actual renewed approval/current checks needed, never self-approval or bypass.

cases.input: Non-draft representative PR lacks selected governed delivered dossier
cases.required_and_documented_response: Do not expect green archive guard. Reuse valid governed contribution or prepare genuine scoped evidence before test; no guard weakening.

cases.input: Applicable access shown for both, one accountable handler actually receives marker, outsider excluded
cases.required_and_documented_response: Satisfy R4 public receipt requirement if actually observed; no second notification/reply or simulated handover.

cases.input: One maintainer lacks applicable access, no handler receipt, or outsider sees report
cases.required_and_documented_response: Keep public route unverified and fallback visible. No automatic extra report, credential substitution or permission escalation.

cases.input: Actual handler becomes unavailable
cases.required_and_documented_response: Coordinate and record real acknowledged handover when needed; do not fabricate a pre-publication exercise.

cases.input: Planning approved/admin access exists, but no scoped operation authority
cases.required_and_documented_response: Stop before GitHub write/message/publication; all current work stays private/local.

cases.input: Final SHA, operator, all human/bot writer idle agreement or test audience unavailable
cases.required_and_documented_response: Stop before visibility. Empty queues/old participation are not a current freeze agreement.

cases.input: 403, contradictory readback or stronger inherited rule
cases.required_and_documented_response: 403 is unknown; preserve stronger rule and review exact delta, not blanket overwrite.

cases.input: Protection not verified within 900 seconds or source/session drifts
cases.required_and_documented_response: Stop ordinary rollout/merges/releases, retain freeze/evidence and obtain scoped containment; no silent retry/reset/reversal.

cases.input: Public exact commit works but no versioned release/consumer migration
cases.required_and_documented_response: Opening smoke does not claim release/update availability; later exact-version work remains separate.

cases.input: 143 behavior/resource files and runtime match real rehearsal
cases.required_and_documented_response: Reuse six actual private cases with original hashes; changed reporting prose is reviewed here, not called a new native execution.
